t_advice_summary_textbox.text: 2 important features in the game: the gnomes appear in fixed pairs and the second feature is that each gnome will lead me to a different forest, a bright forest and a dark forest.

vb_textbox.text: HI! Here are a few things that i noticed in the game and i hope that it will help.1. I noticed that the gnomes come in pairs of: orange and brown, green and pink, red and yellow, blue and purple. 2. Each gnome will take you to a different forest, one greener with a red basket and one a bit darker with a yellow basket. The orange, green, red and blue gnomes lead you to the greener forest, while the brown, pink and yellow to the darker forest.Your goal is to get as many mushrooms as possible.I noticed that, either when choosing the gnomes that lead you to the greener forest or the gnomes that leads you to the darker forest, in each forest i got many mushrooms or even nothing.Good luck and enjoy the game.
